title: Stroud Township Borders to remain open
summary: The Borders bookstore in Stroud Township will remain open despite Borders Group Inc. filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection. Nationwide, Borders plans to close about 30 percent of its stores, including nine locations in Pennsylvania, but the Stroud Township store was not among the 200 initial closures announced. The company's President, Mike Edwards, stated that the Chapter 11 filing will allow Borders to access new capital and reorganize its operations amidst a challenging retail environment.
